note: Supplementary file - NOT a new line. 'Fratello Bianco' already exists on the site (just 'Bianco I', 6.25x44). Adding 2 genuine additional vitolas the site is missing.

additional_vitolas.name: Bianco Nero Riserva
additional_vitolas.notes: A limited reimagining of the Bianco blend in a maduro wrapper, not the standard Connecticut-style Bianco. Debuted at InterTabac; shipped to U.S. retailers December 16, 2024. Limited to 500 boxes of 10 (5,000 cigars total). Fratello has said it could become regular production later.

additional_vitolas.name: Bianco Fuoco
additional_vitolas.notes: 'Fuoco' is a shared short-robusto vitola/format Fratello released simultaneously across 3 lines (Bianco, Classico, Oro) using each line's own existing blend - not a standalone 4th line. First offered to European retailers 2019; U.S. retail ~2021-2022 (shown at PCA 2021). Sold in 30-count boxes, ~$7.50/cigar.
